City Council and Successor Agency Regular Meetings
AGENDA
MEETING OF
THE LA PUENTE CITY COUNCIL AND
SUCCESSOR AGENCY
COUNCIL CHAMBERS
15900 EAST MAIN STREET, LA PUENTE
DECEMBER 8, 2015
07:00
P.M.
CALL TO ORDER
ROLL CALL
COUNCIL/AGENCY MEMBERS: Holloway, Munoz, Argudo, Klinakis and Lewis
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
Young Marines Color Guard
PRESENTATIONS
Introduction of Sunset Elementary, Workman Elementary, Sierra Vista Middle School and Sparks Middle School Students Attending the City Council Meeting
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
If you wish to address the City Council - Successor Agency on an item other than a closed session and public hearing matter, please complete the Request for Oral Presentation form and submit it to the City Clerk no later than prior to the conclusion of the first speaker's remarks. (Ordinance No. 06-843.)
E.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL
E-1
CONSIDERATION AND POSSIBLE ACTION REGARDING A REQUEST FROM MR. S. CLAUS FOR VARIANCES FROM THE CITYâ€™S MUNICIPAL CODE
It is recommended that the City Council It is recommended that the City Council approve Resolution No. 15-5253: (1) granting a free business license for a non-profit organization (LPMC 5.04.180); (2) waiving the Noise Ordinance to permit the sound of bells (LPMC 4.34); (3) waiving the Trespass Ordinance (LPMC 3.16.130); (4) waiving the ordinance on Animal Regulations (LPMC 10.50.040); or (5) alternatively, discuss and take other action regarding this item.
E-1 Santa Claus Staff Report
E-1 Santa Claus Resolution
E-2
CONSIDERATION OF AN ORDINANCE ADDING CHAPTER 3.76 (SHOPPING CART REGULATIONS) TO TITLE 3 (PUBLIC SAFETY AND MORALS) OF THE LA PUENTE MUNICIPAL CODE
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) waive reading of ordinance and read by title only; and (2) introduce Ordinance No. 15-938 - an Ordinance of the City Council of the City of La Puente adding Chapter 3.76 (Shopping Cart Regulations) to Title 3 (Public Safety and Morals) of the La Puente Municipal Code.
E-2 Shopping Cart Staff Report
E-2 Shopping Cart Attachment A Ordinance
BOARDS/COMMISSION/COMMITTEE REPORTS
A.
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETINGS
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETINGS OF NOVEMBER 10, 2015, AND NOVEMBER 17, 2015
It is recommended that the City Council and Successor Agency waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the City Council and Successor Agency meetings of November 10, 2015, and November 17, 2015.
A-1 Minutes 11-10-15 CC-SA
A-1 Minutes 11-17-15 CC-SA
B.
PUBLIC HEARINGS BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL
B-1
CONSIDERATION OF MUNICIPAL CODE AMENDMENT NO. 139 - AN ORDINANCE TO AMEND TABLE 2-5 (CM ZONE-ALLOWED USES AND PERMIT REQUIREMENTS) OF SECTION 10.14.020 (LAND USE REGULATIONS) OF CHAPTER 10.14 (COMMERCIAL-MANUFACTURING ZONE) OF TITLE 10 (ZONING) OF THE LA PUENTE MUNICIPAL CODE TO ALLOW COMMERCIAL RECREATION AND ENTERTAINMENT USES IN THE COMMERCIAL MANUFACTURING ZONE SUBJECT TO APPROVAL OF A CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT FOR ALL SUCH USES AND APPROVAL OF AN INITIAL STUDY/NEGATIVE DECLARATION FOR SAME
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) open the public hearing and take public testimony; (2) waive reading of ordinance and read by title only; (3) introduce Ordinance No. 15-937 - an Ordinance of the City Council of the City of La Puente Amending Table 2-5 (CM Zone-Allowed Uses and Permit Requirements) of Section 10.14.020 (Land Use Regulations) of Chapter 10.14 (Commercial-Manufacturing Zone) of Title 10 (Zoning) of the La Puente Municipal Code to allow commercial recreation and entertainment uses in the Commercial Manufacturing Zone subject to the approval of a conditional use permit for all such uses; and (4) approve the Initial Study/Negative Declaration with comments from LASD for same.
B-1 MCA 139 Staff Report
B-1 MCA 139 Attachment A PC Resolution
B-1 MCA 139 Attachment B Ordinance
C.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL â€“ None
D.
CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council/Successor Agency, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council/Successor Agency. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1398
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 15-5249 approving Warrant Register No. 1398.
D-1 Warrant Register #1398
D-2
CONSIDERATION OF A JOINT TAX SHARING RESOLUTION WITH THE COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES BOARD OF SUPERVISORS APPROVING AND ACCEPTING NEGOTIATED EXCHANGE OF PROPERTY TAX REVENUES RESULTING FROM ANNEXATION OF PROPERTY LOCATED AT 1545 HACIENDA BOULEVARD (APN 8471-020-035) INTO SANITATION DISTRICT NO. 15 (ANNEXATION NO. 295)
It is recommended that the City Council adopt the attached joint resolution with the Los Angeles County Board of Supervisors approving and accepting negotiated exchange of property revenues resulting from annexation of the property located at 1545 Hacienda Boulevard (APN 8471-020-035) into Sanitation District No. 15 (Annexation No. 295).
D-2 Sewer District Annexation Staff Report
D-2 Sewer District Annexation Attachment A Letter
D-3
AUTHORIZATION TO SOLICIT BIDS FOR CONCRETE REPAIRS AT VARIOUS LOCATIONS CITYWIDE
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve the specifications for the Construction of the Concrete Repairs at Various Locations Citywide; and (2) authorize staff to solicit bids.
D-3 Concrete Repairs Staff Report
D-4
CONSIDERATION OF: (1) RESOLUTION 15-5250, A RESOLUTION RESCINDING RESOLUTION 15-5226, AND AMENDING THE COMPREHENSIVE PERSONNEL SYSTEM AND ESTABLISHING THE NUMBER OF AUTHORIZED FULL-TIME POSITIONS AND MONTHLY RANGES FOR CITY EMPLOYEES; AND (2) RESOLUTION 15-5251, AMENDING THE COMPREHENSIVE PERSONNEL SYSTEM AND ESTABLISHING THE NUMBER OF AUTHORIZED PART-TIME POSITIONS AND HOURLY RATES FOR CITY EMPLOYEES
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve Resolution 15-5250 rescinding Resolution 15-5226 and amending the comprehensive personnel system and establishing the number of authorized full-time positions and monthly ranges for City employees; and (2) approve Resolution 15-5251 establishing the number of authorized part-time positions and hourly rates for City employees.
D-4 Salary Resolution Staff Report
D-4 Attachment A Full Time Salary Resolution
D-4 Attachment B Part Time Salary Resolution
D-5
RECEIVE AND FILE THE CITYâ€™S COMPREHENSIVE ANNUAL FINANCIAL REPORT FOR FISCAL YEAR ENDED JUNE 30, 2015
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file the Comprehensive Annual Financial Report, the Independent Accountantâ€™s report on the Appropriations Limit Worksheet, the Independent Auditorâ€™s Report on Internal Control and the Statement on Auditing Standard No. 114 Report for the fiscal year ended June 30, 2015.
D-5 CAFR Staff Report
D-5 CAFR Attachment A Report
D-5 CAFR Attachment B Accountant's Report
D-5 CAFR Attachment C Internal Control Report
D-5 CAFR Attachment D Statement on Auditing Standard
ADHOC COMMITTEE REPORTS
Council Members provide a report on any Ad Hoc Committee meetings that they have attended.
AB 1234 REPORTS
ORAL COMMENTS FROM COUNCIL
ORAL COMMENTS FROM STAFF
ADJOURNMENT
AVAILABILITY
Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council/Successor Agency regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public inspection during normal business hours at City Hall located at 15900 E. Main Street, the La Puente Community Center located at 501 North Glendora and the Los Angeles County Library located at 15920 E. Central. In addition, such writings and documents will be posted on the City's website at http://www.lapuente.org.
AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (626) 855-1500. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
MEETING TIMES
Meetings of the City Council shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727).
CERTIFICATION
